method: Manual selection of ten existing officially read named units at nine B-owned institutions, then exact same-institution source tuple enumeration; no fresh reads/public edits.

supportingUnits.name: Department of Management and Marketing

supportingUnits.name: Operations Management

validation: All exact tuples pass pure reconcileSourceUnit evidence URL/date/unit validation. Prior pending tuple snapshot retained in continuation285. No merger commands.
limitations: All records remain proposals. This does not close other source assertions at these institutions.
